name: io.github.chrischall/alphaportal-mcp
description: AlphaPortal school-bus transportation for Claude — students, stops, live bus location, notifications

environmentVariables.name: ALPHAPORTAL_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional refresh token; if unset, read from a signed-in tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension

environmentVariables.name: ALPHAPORTAL_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to `1` to disable the browser-bridge fallback and require ALPHAPORTAL_REFRESH_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost concentrator port (default 37149). On one machine every MCP shares the concentrator, so move it for ALL of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity.
